prerequisites: Students must have passed at least 120 ECTS of the study plan.
Students who have already completed the entire curriculum or are already graduates cannot participate.

learning_outcomes.text: Contribute to the comprehensive training of students, complementing their theoretical and practical teachings.
Facilitate knowledge of the appropriate work methodology for the professional reality in which students will operate as graduates, contrasting and applying acquired knowledge.
Promote the development of decision-making capacity and critical thinking of students.

syllabus_topics: Particular conditions of each internship placement

assessment_methods.method: Internship Report - Description of the company, size and importance
Internship Report - Description of tasks performed
Internship Report - Relationship of tasks with university studies
Internship Report - Learning contributed by the internship

assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as 0.5 * Internship Report Grade + 0.5 * Follow-up Grade. A minimum of 4 points is required in both the Internship Report Grade and the Follow-up Grade to pass the subject. The final grade must be 5 or higher to pass the subject. If the minimum in the Internship Report Grade and/or Follow-up Grade is not reached, the maximum final grade will be 4 points. Extraordinary calls follow the same procedure as ordinary calls.
